entries.def: (= a book of information for tourists)
entries.example: When you are sightseeing, it helps to buy a guidebook and a map of the town you are visiting.
We went sightseeing almost every day.

entries.word: do a bit of/a lot of sightseeing
entries.example: I didn't do a lot of sightseeing in Warsaw.
We had a quick look round the shops.
I took hundreds of pictures on holiday.
I spent lots of money – too much.
We got lost almost every day in London.
They had a lovely time in Venice.

entries.def: (= leave home/your hotel to go to a social event, e.g. restaurant or disco)
entries.example: On holiday we went out every night.
Bruges is a lovely place and we found a really nice place (= hotel) to stay.
The town is full of interesting places.
Venice is beautiful but it's always packed with tourists.

entries.def: (= full of people from different countries and cultures)
(= important places built a long time ago)
entries.example: St Petersburg has lots of historic monuments.
Many beautiful cities are now very touristy.
São Paolo is a really lively place and the nightlife is fantastic.
A: If I go to Scotland, is it worth spending a few days in Edinburgh? B: Yes, definitely – and Glasgow is worth a visit as well.
